**ONE ONLY**

# **What It Is**

One Only is a token launchpad on Solana that solves a specific problem with Pump.fun-style platforms: anyone can mint unlimited tokens with the exact same ticker, so the moment a narrative breaks a real news event, a viral moment dozens of identical-looking tokens compete for attention and buyers can't tell which one is “real.” One Only enforces exactly one listing per ticker, platform-wide, permanently. Name a ticker once, and it's the only one that will ever exist on the platform.

# **System at a Glance**

Five stages cover the entire lifecycle of a ticker on the platform:

* Claim: a creator submits a ticker, name, description, and PFP; the ticker is checked against the registry and reserved if it's unused.

* Activate: the claim only becomes real once the creator buys at least $5 of their own token; this is what earns them the 0,5% creator fee going forward.

* Trade: the token trades on its Meteora DBC bonding curve against whichever pair the creator chose, until it either graduates or delist from UI.

* Delist: any pool with 30 days of less 100$ volume ; once every pool on a ticker is quiet, the name itself is released back into the registry for someone new to claim.

# **What We're Building On**

We're building on Meteora's Dynamic Bonding Curve (DBC), not wrapping Pump.fun's own contract. DBC is an open Solana program that lets us run our own launchpad: our own fee schedule, our own bonding curve, our own migration destination. Like Pump.fun, it needs no upfront liquidity: a virtual reserve curve fills entirely from real trader buys, and once a token crosses its migration threshold it graduates into a real Meteora AMM pool (DAMM v2), funded from those accumulated reserves. Neither we nor the creator ever have to supply capital to seed a pool.

We have our own CA (meteora allows it) \- on1y. Cost? Pregrind? That’s the Pump-style setup: grind ahead, stamp “on1y” on every OneOnly meme.

# **The Uniqueness Rule**

The match key is the ticker symbol, exact match, normalized (uppercase, strip a leading “$”, strip whitespace, checked against Unicode look-alike characters), and enforced only within One Only's own registry we don't police duplicates minted elsewhere on Solana. One ticker can exist exactly once on the platform, full stop, regardless of what it's paired against.

# **Creating a Token**

A creator submits a ticker, name, description, and PFP, and picks one starting pair: SOL, USDC, or one of five tokenized-stock pairs (xStocks, issued by Backed Finance: SPYx, QQQx, NVDAx, TSLAx, CRCLx). Creator status — and the fee rights that come with it — only activates once they buy at least $5 of their own token. That $5 stake is the anti-squat mechanic.

# **Fees & Revenue**

Every pool charges total 1,25% fee on trade. How that's split depends on how the pool came to exist:&nbsp;

0,25% meteora (thier 20% cut)

0,5% \- creator

0,5% \- one only

# **Keeping the Registry Clean**

Any single pool goes quiet, it is delisted from one only after 30 days with less than 100$ trading volume. The ticker itself is only freed up for someone else to claim once every one of its pools has gone quiet; a ticker with one dead pool and one active pool stays claimed.&nbsp;

# **Launch Plan (context, not a spec)**

* Pre-launch: a waitlist capturing x connect (lowest tier if free just view, optional) \+ wallet address (plain text field, no signature verification — it's for notifications only), plus a self-attestation checkbox excluding US persons / restricted jurisdictions.

* Invited influencers and top traders are announced on X one at a time, roughly 7/day, with no special tickers, tokens, or payment attached — the invitation itself is the incentive.

* The platform (token creation and trading) stays closed until the full announcement campaign wraps, then goes live all at once.

* $OneOnly launches the same day as the platform: 100% fair launch through the same bonding-curve mechanism as any other token, no team pre-mine. 50% of One Only's platform revenue continuously buys back $OneOnly and burns it.
